title: Traditional Moroccan Mechoui
description: Mechoui is a slow-cooked lamb dish originating from Morocco, traditionally cooked in a hole in the ground. This recipe is a simplified version of the classic dish.

ingredients.name: Moroccan spices
ingredients.notes: a mix of cumin, coriander, cinnamon, ginger

instructions: Season the lamb shoulder with salt and black pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Sear the lamb shoulder until browned on all sides.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the Moroccan spices and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Transfer the Dutch oven to the preheated oven and cook for 2 1/2 to 3 hours.
Let the lamb rest for 10-15 minutes before slicing and serving.
